hints.title: Sequential Allocation Rule
hints.text: For each fruit type in order from left to right, find the earliest available basket that can hold it.

hints.title: Basket Invalidation
hints.text: Once a basket is chosen, mark it as consumed so no subsequent fruit can use it.

hints.title: Unplaced Counter
hints.text: If no available basket has enough capacity for the current fruit, increment the unplaced count.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: n: number of fruits and baskets
complexity.notes: Scans up to n baskets for each of the n fruits, executing in under 10000 operations for n <= 100.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear scanning works easily within the small constraint n <= 100.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct in-place array updates eliminate auxiliary complex tree overhead for small n.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Write clear greedy simulation respecting leftmost available basket constraints.
